gloss: bank seal (a personal seal registered with one's bank)

definitions.gloss: bank seal — a personal hanko registered with a bank for authorizing transactions
definitions.explanation: In Japan, a personal seal ({印鑑|いんかん}/はんこ) that has been formally registered with a bank as the seal authorized to approve transactions on a particular account. Withdrawals over the counter, account changes, and other major bank business have traditionally required impressing the registered {銀行印|ぎんこういん}. Distinct from the everyday {認印|みとめいん} used for casual signing and from {実印|じついん}, the seal registered with city hall for legal purposes.

examples.japanese: {銀行印|ぎんこういん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{必要|ひつよう}→必要：00846_hitsuyou⟧です。
⟦{口座|こうざ}→口座：05419_kouza⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{開|ひら}く→開く：01979_hiraku⟧{時|とき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{銀行印|ぎんこういん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{登録|とうろく}した→登録する：25227_tourokusuru⟧。
examples.english: I registered a bank seal when I opened the account.

examples.japanese: {銀行印|ぎんこういん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{家|いえ}→家：00612_ie⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{大事|だいじ}→大事：01253_daiji⟧な⟦{書類|しょるい}→書類：01103_shorui⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{一緒|いっしょ}→一緒：02848_issho⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{保管|ほかん}している→保管する：25536_hokansuru⟧。
examples.english: I keep my bank seal stored together with the important documents at home.

examples.japanese: ⟦{最近|さいきん}→最近：00881_saikin⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{銀行印|ぎんこういん}なし⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{手続|てつづ}き→手続き：05453_tetsuzuki⟧⟦できる→できる：00557_dekiru⟧⟦{口座|こうざ}→口座：05419_kouza⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{増|ふ}えて→増える：01183_fueru⟧きた⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{昔|むかし}→昔：01515_mukashi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{窓口|まどぐち}→窓口：03154_madoguchi⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{取引|とりひき}→取引：04700_torihiki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{欠|か}かせなかった→欠かす：10138_kakasu⟧。
examples.english: Lately more accounts can be handled without a bank seal, but in the past it was indispensable for any business at a teller window.

notes:
{銀行印|ぎんこういん} is one of the three traditional categories of personal seals in Japan, alongside ⟦{実印|じついん}→実印：07490_jitsuin⟧ and ⟦{認印|みとめいん}→認印：07489_mitomein⟧. It is registered with a particular bank, kept separate from everyday-use seals, and produced when authorizing transactions like passbook reissues and large withdrawals.

FORMS:
- ⟦{銀行|ぎんこう}→銀行：00578_ginkou⟧ ("bank") + {印|いん} ("seal, stamp") → {銀行印|ぎんこういん}

THE THREE-SEAL SYSTEM:
- ⟦{実印|じついん}→実印：07490_jitsuin⟧: the registered legal seal — registered at city hall, used for major contracts (real estate, car purchases)
- {銀行印|ぎんこういん}: bank seal — registered with a specific bank for account business
- ⟦{認印|みとめいん}→認印：07489_mitomein⟧: everyday seal — for routine acknowledgements (parcels, in-house documents); not officially registered

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {銀行印|ぎんこういん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{登録|とうろく}する→登録する：25227_tourokusuru⟧: to register a bank seal
- {銀行印|ぎんこういん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{押|お}す→押す：02854_osu⟧: to stamp the bank seal
- {銀行印|ぎんこういん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{変更|へんこう}する→変更する：30779_henkousuru⟧: to change one's registered bank seal
- {銀行印|ぎんこういん}⟦{紛失|ふんしつ}→紛失：14894_funshitsu⟧: loss of a bank seal
- {銀行印|ぎんこういん}{届|とどけ}: notice of bank-seal change

SIMILAR / RELATED TERMS:
- ⟦{印鑑|いんかん}→印鑑：05290_inkan⟧: a personal seal (general term)
- はんこ: stamp, seal (everyday word, written in kana)
- ⟦{実印|じついん}→実印：07490_jitsuin⟧: registered legal seal
- ⟦{認印|みとめいん}→認印：07489_mitomein⟧: everyday seal (not registered)
- ⟦{印鑑|いんかん}{登録|とうろく}→印鑑登録：07491_inkantouroku⟧: seal registration (the act of officially registering)
- ⟦{朱肉|しゅにく}→朱肉：06192_shuniku⟧: red ink-paste used to stamp seals

CULTURAL NOTE:
- Japan's seal system has long substituted for handwritten signatures in many official contexts. Each individual is expected to keep their ⟦{実印|じついん}→実印：07490_jitsuin⟧, {銀行印|ぎんこういん}, and ⟦{認印|みとめいん}→認印：07489_mitomein⟧ separate so that loss of one does not compromise the others.
- Many banks now allow online and signature-based authentication for routine transactions; even so, a {銀行印|ぎんこういん} is often still required to open the account or make major changes.
